title: Enable additional ruff rule categories
description:
The ruff config in puppeteer/pyproject.toml has good coverage but is missing several high-value categories. Enable these one at a time, fix violations, and add to the selected rules:

- C4 (flake8-comprehensions): unnecessary list/dict/set comprehension patterns
- PT (flake8-pytest-style): pytest best practices
- ERA (eradicator): commented-out code
- TCH (flake8-type-checking): move type-only imports into TYPE_CHECKING blocks
- S (bandit/security): hardcoded passwords, unsafe yaml.load, etc.
- N (pep8-naming): naming conventions
- ARG (flake8-unused-arguments): unused function arguments
- FBT (flake8-boolean-trap): boolean positional args

Each category should be a separate commit so violations are easy to review. Some categories (e.g. FBT, N) may need per-file ignores for existing code.
